name: trading-system
description: A production-inspired centralized cryptocurrency exchange built in Rust to study low-latency backend systems, order matching algorithms, concurrency, and scalable service architecture. The project prioritizes correctness, performance, and systems design over CRUD functionality.

name: Minecraft
description: Developed a Minecraft-inspired game engine from scratch using C and OpenGL, focusing on low-level graphics programming and real-time rendering. The project includes voxel-based world representation.

name: Sketch-AI
description: A visual learning tool that combines Excalidraw with large language models to generate dynamic diagrams, flowcharts, and animations for complex topics in physics, mathematics, and engineering.

name: sorting-algo-visualiser
description: Implemented a real-time sorting algorithm visualization engine in C using Raylib, and algorithmic clarity. The system visually represents sorting processes step-by-step, providing intuitive insight into algorithmic behavior.

name: raycasting-js
description: A from-scratch implementation of a 2D raycasting engine in JavaScript, inspired by early 3D games like Wolfenstein 3D.

name: Break-The-Code
description: Break-The-Code is an interactive problem-solving platform where developers intentionally break code while an LLM attempts to debug and fix it. Built using Docker and Next.js.
